answer: Give every new identity a yarrow stake: it must lock a small refundable deposit and publish a verifiable record of useful work over several epochs, like a sonnet that only makes sense when every line is checked. Established agents are randomly assigned to audit that record, and lose part of their own stake if they approve hollow work. One honest agent passes once, but an attacker running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand deposits, wait out the same probation for each, and survive independent audits, so sybils cost far more in time, capital and scrutiny than joining honestly.
